expectedBlocked: Without an actually accessible installed copy, supported discovery operations, separate loading authorization, complete enumeration or identity receipt, report the precise block. Source reads and structural catalogs do not establish discovery.
expectedFull: Complete direct or worker-assisted installed-copy discovery proves the exact frozen SHA, version, actual copy identity, all root names and Benny exclusions, with every discovery observation bound to its exposed operation. Workers are optional for this case.
expectedReduced: A missing independent orchestration requirement in a larger task may be disclosed as reduced, but this discovery gate still requires the complete installed-copy receipt and three actual observations. Merely choosing direct discovery is full completion.
forbiddenClaims: Direct source-file reads or a local source directory prove installed discovery.
A receipt is complete with fewer than 56 root skills or with any Benny root registration.
Observation labels are exposed tool names by definition.
Historical or differently frozen evidence proves the current installed package.
prompt: In each fresh host, after separately authorized supported package loading, inspect the actual installed copy and enumerate its registered root skills. Preserve the exact final frozen package identity and distinguish an unavailable discovery operation from readable local source.
requirements: Bind discover-package, enumerate-skills and inspect-installed-copy observation labels to actually exposed operations. These labels are not callable APIs and authorize no installation.
Observe exactly all 54 candidate root skill names and exclude all three canonical automations/benny/skills/*/SKILL.md paths from root discovery.

Retain a JSON receipt with exactly schemaVersion: 1, kind: pstack-package-discovery, host, packageCommit, packageVersion, installedCopy, rootSkills and excludedSkills. The host matches the evidence record; packageCommit is the exact final frozen tested SHA; version is the tested package version; installedCopy is the actual observed nonempty host-copy identity, never an inferred source path. rootSkills and excludedSkills are sorted exact arrays.

List the receipt in artifacts and reference it from the inspect-installed-copy successful operation. A .txt receipt may hold JSON inside the evidence directory; a .json receipt belongs outside that directory.

Direct full completion requires the complete receipt and all three actual discovery observations. No worker or execution grant is required solely for observation through a native host interface. If workers are used, bind their spawn and inspected results. Reduced cases may not weaken enumeration or installed identity.
Record both hosts independently. Missing, denied, incomplete or unobserved discovery remains blocked or not-run. Preserve the tested SHA when later reports use a different report commit.
